def fractBasisC (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (↑(Int.fract ((k : ℝ) / x)) : ℂ)

/-- The target function: 1_{(0,1)}, as a ℂ-valued function.
    This is the function we want to approximate in L². -/

def targetFnC (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if 0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1 then 1 else 0
